title: mykel's landclaiming
description: a pretty simple landclaiming plugin for Folia
body:
## mykel's landclaiming a simple folia plugin that adds a claim system. ### commands /landclaiming - plugin command
/claim - claim a chunk
/unclaim - unclaim a chunk
/trust - trust a player in a chunk
/untrust - untrust a player in a chunk
/claimadmin [player] - administrate claims
### notice the plugin is still in early development. whilst the current versions are stable, it may miss some features. if you have any bugs / feature requests, please join the discord.
